name: RegulatorySubmissionTracker
tagline: Every eCTD sequence, review clock, HA question and commitment – in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete regulatory affairs app for Power Apps and Power Pages: plan and submit eCTD sequences per market, follow review clocks with clock stops, answer health-authority questions before the deadline, record approvals with post-approval commitments and see every product's registration status on one approval timeline.
features: Configurable review clocks per submission type (MAA, NDA/BLA, Type IA/IB/II, PAS, CBE-30, renewals, PSURs)
eCTD sequence numbering with duplicate check and next-sequence proposal
Second-person publishing QC sign-off before submission
Approval with post-approval commitments (PMR/PMC, PAES, RMP)
Timeline per product and market with projected reviews and target decisions
Bulk actions, CSV export, undo, history
Phone layout with bottom view switcher
